functions.name: add-candidate-to-shortlist
functions.description: Add one candidate to a requirement's shortlist.

candidateId.description: Existing candidate ID to associate with the shortlist.

requirementId.description: Requirement whose shortlist receives the candidate; must fit int32.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_addcandidatetos.description: The existing candidate and requirement to associate through shortlist membership.

message.description: Useful provider acknowledgement text if present; omitted otherwise.

accepted.description: Provider acknowledged the add request; does not establish downstream workflow or delivery.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_addcandidateto.description: Provider acknowledgement of the requested shortlist membership addition.

tags.instructions: Get a requirement ID from `list-requirements` and a candidate ID from `list-candidates`. This creates shortlist membership, not a candidate or requirement. Use `batch-add-candidates-to-shortlist` for 2–100 candidates or `remove-candidate-from-shortlist` to remove membership. Provider acknowledgement does not imply any hiring decision or notification delivery.

functions.name: batch-add-candidates-to-shortlist
functions.description: Request adding 2–100 candidates to one requirement shortlist in a native multi-candidate call.

items.description: Existing candidate ID containing decimal digits.

candidateIds.description: Two to 100 unique existing candidate IDs; each is a separate target within one aggregate request.

requirementId.description: Requirement receiving all requested shortlist associations; must fit int32.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_batchaddcandida.description: One requirement and two to 100 unique candidates to add to its shortlist.

message.description: Useful aggregate provider acknowledgement text if present; omitted otherwise.

accepted.description: Provider acknowledged the aggregate request; no per-item success or atomicity is inferred.

items.description: Requested candidate ID.

candidateIds.description: Requested candidate IDs in caller order, not a list of independently confirmed successes.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_batchaddcandid.description: Aggregate acknowledgement of the shortlist addition request, not independently confirmed candidate outcomes.

tags.instructions: Obtain requirement and candidate IDs from `list-requirements` and `list-candidates`. Supply 2–100 unique candidates for one requirement; use `add-candidate-to-shortlist` for one. The acknowledgement is aggregate, not per-candidate success, and processing is not promised atomic. Inspect the shortlist before replaying an uncertain or partially applied request.

functions.name: batch-add-entities-to-basket
functions.description: Add up to 500 existing same-type entities to one basket using the native multiple-target operation.

type.description: Type shared by basket and entities.

items.description: Existing entity ID.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_batchaddentitie.description: Destination basket, shared entity type, and distinct entities to add in one batch.

accepted.description: Provider acknowledged the aggregate request; no per-item or atomicity guarantee.

items.description: Submitted entity ID, not a proven per-item success.

requestedEntityIds.description: Submitted IDs in original order; not a list of proven per-item successes.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_batchaddentiti.description: Aggregate acknowledgement of the submitted basket membership addition.

tags.instructions: Get basket ID/type with `list-baskets`. Supply 1–500 distinct entity IDs of that type. Use `add-entity-to-basket` for one entity. Result reports aggregate acceptance, not invented per-item success; do not blindly retry an uncertain batch.

functions.name: batch-remove-candidates-from-shortlist
functions.description: Request removing 2–100 candidates from one requirement shortlist in a native multi-candidate call.

items.description: Candidate ID targeted for shortlist membership removal.

candidateIds.description: Two to 100 unique candidate IDs targeted for membership removal; candidate records themselves remain.

requirementId.description: Requirement whose shortlist associations should be removed; must fit int32.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_batchremovecand.description: One requirement and two to 100 unique candidates whose shortlist memberships should be removed.

message.description: Useful aggregate acknowledgement text if present; omitted otherwise.

accepted.description: Provider acknowledged the aggregate removal request; does not establish atomic or per-item success.

items.description: Requested candidate ID, not an independently confirmed removal.

candidateIds.description: Requested candidate IDs in caller order; not independently confirmed removals.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_batchremovecan.description: Aggregate acknowledgement of the requested shortlist removals, without per-candidate outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use 2–100 unique candidate IDs and one requirement ID obtained from the relevant List tools or a known shortlist. Use `remove-candidate-from-shortlist` for one candidate. Only associations are removed; candidates and the requirement are not deleted. The result is aggregate, not per-item success, and atomicity is not promised. Inspect membership before replaying an uncertain request.

functions.name: batch-remove-entities-from-basket
functions.description: Remove up to 500 same-type entity associations from a basket without deleting records.

type.description: Type shared by basket and entities.

items.description: Entity ID whose basket association is to be removed.

entityIds.description: Distinct entity IDs to remove, maximum 500.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_batchremoveenti.description: Basket, shared entity type, and distinct entity IDs for one membership-removal batch.

accepted.description: Aggregate provider acceptance; not an atomicity or per-item success statement.

items.description: Submitted entity ID, not a proven individual removal.

requestedEntityIds.description: Submitted IDs in original order, not proven individual removals.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_batchremoveent.description: Aggregate acceptance of the submitted basket membership-removal request.

tags.instructions: Get basket ID/type using `list-baskets`. Supply 1–500 distinct IDs; use `remove-entity-from-basket` for one entity. Removes memberships only. Aggregate acceptance does not establish per-item success or prior membership.

functions.name: create-activity
functions.description: Create a note or todo, optionally connected to candidates, clients, requirements, contracts and users, with an optional alarm.

type.description: Create a note or a todo.

userIds.description: User IDs associated with the activity; omission or empty means no explicit user list.

items.description: User ID, preserved verbatim.

startsAt.description: Note/todo date as an RFC 3339 instant with explicit offset and whole-second precision; provider timezone mapping is provisional.

clientIds.description: Client-contact IDs to connect; omission or empty means no client links.

items.description: Client-contact ID, preserved verbatim.

noteTypeId.description: Note-type ID from candidate or client lookups; must fit int32.

contractIds.description: Contract IDs to connect; omission or empty means no contract links.

items.description: Contract ID, preserved verbatim.

createAlarm.description: Whether to request an alarm; defaults to false.

description.description: Ordinary note or todo text, including Unicode and empty text if accepted by the provider.

candidateIds.description: Candidate IDs to connect; omission or an empty array creates no candidate links.

items.description: Candidate ID, preserved verbatim.

requirementIds.description: Requirement IDs to connect; omission or empty means no requirement links.

items.description: Requirement ID, preserved verbatim.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_createactivity.description: A new note or todo, its start instant, optional entity connections and alarm choice.

id.description: New activity ID if returned unambiguously; omitted if the provider does not return one.

message.description: Provider acknowledgement text when useful and present; omitted otherwise.

accepted.description: The provider acknowledged the create request; this does not establish alarm delivery or per-link success.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_createactivity.description: Provider acceptance of one activity creation request, not confirmation of individual connections or alarm delivery.

tags.instructions: Use for a new note or todo, not for modifying existing activities. Get note-type IDs from candidate/client lookups and user IDs from `list-users`; obtain other IDs from the corresponding List tools. The tool can create an alarm. A successful result means provider acceptance, not alarm delivery. Do not blindly retry an uncertain write because it may create duplicates.

functions.name: create-basket
functions.description: Create an empty basket for one supported entity type, optionally owned by a chosen user.

type.description: Kind of entities the new basket holds.

ownerUserId.description: Optional owner user ID; omission leaves ownership to provider behavior.

FunctionInput_chameleoni_createbasket.description: Name and entity type for an empty basket, with an optional owner.

ownerUserId.description: Resolved owner when confirmed by provider; omitted if unknown.

FunctionOutput_chameleoni_createbasket.description: Created basket and any ownership explicitly reported by the provider.

tags.instructions: Choose the entity type and name. Optional owner ID comes from the account's users list. Use `batch-add-entities-to-basket` after creation to populate it. Repeating may create another basket.

functions.description: Create a candidate with contact details, eligibility, an optional note, and CV or attachment bytes.

note.description: Optional note created with this candidate.

titleId.description: Title option ID from candidate lookups.

countryId.description: Country option ID from candidate lookups.

filename.description: Filename displayed for the uploaded bytes.

functions.name: create-company
functions.description: Create a company with optional contact details, classification, owner, and attachments.

statusId.description: Status option ID from company lookups.

documents.description: Attachments to create; omitted or empty adds none.

items.description: An attachment to create with the company.
